diagnosis: Activated PI3Kδ syndrome (APDS)-associated lymphadenopathy
legend: APDS-associated lymphadenopathy with enlarged germinal centres lacking well-formed mantle zones (<<29906>>). Increased T follicular helper (TFH) cells within the poorly defined germinal centres as shown by PD1 immunohistochemistry (<<29907>>). At higher power, CMV inclusions are observed; expanded monocytoid B-cell areas contain occasional large cells with prominent nucleoli (<<29910>>). Immunohistochemistry for CMV highlights scattered large infected cells (<<29909>>). Scattered variably sized EBV+ lymphoid cells (brown, EBV-encoded small RNA [EBER] in situ hybridization) are B lineage (red, CD79a immunohistochemistry) (<<29911>>).

diagnosis: Inborn error of immunity–associated lymphoid proliferations and lymphomas
legend: A splenectomy specimen from a patient with common variable immunodeficiency shows scattered red pulp lymphohistiocytic infiltrates (<<29916>>). Characteristic hyperplastic germinal centres with poorly formed mantle zones, lacking a splenic marginal zone, and increased epithelioid histiocytes are present (<<29912>>). Some areas of the spleen show expanded and poorly defined white pulp nodules containing scattered immunoblasts and surrounded by wreaths of histiocytes (<<30067>>).

title: Nodal and extranodal lymphoproliferative manifestations of common variable immunodeficiency
tablehtml:
Organ system

Common presentation

Histological findings

Lymph nodes

Lymphadenopathy

Enlarged and poorly defined germinal centres, decreased plasma cells, non-necrotizing granulomas {24789743}

Gastrointestinal tract

Chronic diarrhoea

Increased intraepithelial lymphocytes with villous blunting; nodular lymphoid hyperplasia; decreased lamina propria plasma cells {18043034; 8827031; 20551941}

Liver

Hepatomegaly

Nodular regenerative hyperplasia with intrasinusoidal cytotoxic T-cell proliferation {26493984; 15492992}; granulomatous disease {32117289}

Respiratory tract

Pneumonia, infiltrates on imaging; bronchiectasis

Interstitial lung disease with variable organizing pneumonia, interstitial lymphoid infiltrates, granulomas, and lymphoid hyperplasia {33776995; 32235152}

Extrapulmonary granulomatous/CD8+ T-cell–rich lesions {32117289; 33391274}

Sometimes destructive lesions of skin, eye, lymph nodes, spleen, kidney, and other sites

Non-necrotizing granulomas with variable associated T-cell–rich infiltrate; rarely associated with clonal CD8+ lymphoproliferation {24813299; 11260556}

Spleen

Splenomegaly

Reactive germinal centres, sometimes with marginal zone and periarteriolar lymphoid sheath hyperplasia; epithelioid granulomas in red pulp and around follicles {27158760}

Peripheral blood

Cytopenias

Large granular lymphocytosis {16734610}

title: Pathogenesis, clinical features, and associated lymphoproliferative disorders across major categories of inborn errors of immunity (IEIs) of T and B cells {31953710; 33598806}
tablehtml:
IEI subtype

Pathogenesis

Clinical features

Lymphoproliferative disorders

Predominantly antibody deficiencies: 52% of IEIs worldwide {32720819}

 

Common variable immunodeficiency (~35% of PIDs) {28606585}

Marked decrease in at least two immunoglobulin subsets (IgG and either IgA or IgM or both) often due to defects in B-cell development and maturation; altered T-cell repertoire {26311730; 22042693; 31942606; 33256375}

Infections, autoimmunity, lymphoproliferation; lymphoma and gastric cancer predisposition

EBV+/− DLBCL > EBV+ CHL > EMZL > T-LGLL {32185577; 34255892; 33876323}; cutaneous and other extranodal CD8+ T-cell–rich lymphoid or lymphohistiocytic infiltrates

 

Activated PI3Kδ syndrome (APDS)

Abnormal T-lymphocyte signalling due to gain-of-function mutations in PIK3CD {24165795} or loss-of-function mutations in PIK3R1, PTEN {31111319}

Lymphadenopathy, hepatosplenomegaly, nodular mucosal lymphoid hyperplasia, herpesvirus infections, (EBV, CMV, HSV)

DLBCL > CHL > EMZL > others; majority of DLBCL and CHL cases are EBV+ {27555459; 27221134; 31942637}

 

Hyper-IgM syndrome

Defective class-switch recombination, lack of germinal centres, e.g. AID deficiency {33098766}

Bacterial infections, lymphadenopathy, plasmacytosis

DLBCL, CHL, EMZL {32192142}

 

Agammaglobulinaemia

Decreased to absent B cells, e.g. mutations in BTK (X-linked agammaglobulinaemia) {24909997}

Severe bacterial infections

Lymphoma uncommon {33584693}; rare cutaneous granulomatous CD8+ T-cell lymphoproliferative disorder {24813299}

Combined immunodeficiencies: 10.8% of IEIs worldwide {32720819}

 

Syndromic combined immunodeficiencies with predisposition to malignancy (AT, NBS)

Pleiotropic DNA repair defects, e.g. ATM deficiency (AT) {25488969; 7792600}

Infection, developmental abnormalities, radiation sensitivity (see <<8.0.0.4>>Ataxia–telangiectasia)

AT: DLBCL, BL, CHL, T-LBL, rarely T-PLL {25488969; 31057537}

NBS: DLBCL > T-LBL > PTCL > others {33488600}

 

SCIDs

Defects in core T-cell development and signalling pathways or DNA recombination repair, e.g. DCLRE1C (ARTEMIS) deficiency {11336668}

Severe infection susceptibility; subset radiosensitive

Lymphoma rarely reported; usually EBV+ DLBCL {31057537}

 

Leaky SCID, Omenn syndrome

Hypomorphic versions of SCID e.g. DCLRE1C (ARTEMIS) deficiency {26476407}

Infection, adenopathy, rash, eosinophilia, granulomatous lesions

EBV+ DLBCL {31057537}; rare cutaneous granulomatous CD8+ T-cell lymphoproliferative disorder {31313695}

 

Combined immunodeficiencies

Defects in less critical or downstream T-cell signalling pathways or cytoskeletal proteins, e.g. WAS {12196287; 26371186}; CD154 (CD40L) deficiency {7679801; 7678782}

Infection, autoimmunity; subset with thrombocytopenia (Wiskott–Aldrich syndrome)

DLBCL > BL > CHL > other, often EBV+ {31057537}

 

Thymic defects with additional congenital abnormalities

Lack of thymic development with associated developmental abnormalities, e.g. del22q11.2 {32668295}

Infections, developmental abnormalities (e.g. velocardiofacial/DiGeorge syndrome)

Rare case report of EBV+ B-cell lymphoma {31057537}

 

Immuno-osseous dysplasias

Pleiotropic cellular defects, e.g. mutations in RMRP (cartilage-hair hypoplasia) {17701897}

Skeletal abnormalities, bone marrow failure, and immunodeficiency

B-cell lymphoma {31057537}

 

Hyper-IgE syndromes

T-cell subset defects with dysregulated IgE production, e.g. STAT3 (Job syndrome) {20159255}

High IgE, pyogenic infections, skeletal/dental abnormalities

DLBCL > CHL > BL > T-cell lymphoma; minority EBV+ {20859667}

Immune dysregulation

 

Familial HLH syndromes {32542393}

T-cell hyperactivation leading to histiocyte activation, e.g. mutations in PRF1 (familial HLH type 2), LYST (Chédiak–Higashi syndrome) {21878672}

HLH, hepatosplenomegaly; Chédiak–Higashi syndrome: hypopigmentation, platelet and neutrophil defects

Predominance of HLH; lymphoma rare

 

Autosomal dominant immune dysregulation syndrome

CTLA4 dominant negative loss of function {25329329}

Autoimmunity, lymphoproliferation, infections

Enriched for EBV+ CHL; CD4+ T-cell–rich extranodal infiltrates {30250467}

 

Regulatory T-cell defects

Lack or dysfunction of CD4+ CD25+ regulatory T cells, increased autoreactive T cells, e.g. FOXP3 deficiency (IPEX) {30443250}

Autoimmunity, lymphoproliferation, infections, inflammatory bowel disease

Predominance of HLH; lymphoma rare

 

ALPS (see <<5.1.0.3>>Autoimmune lymphoproliferative syndrome)

Defective T-cell apoptosis, e.g. FAS (TNFRSF6) deficiency (ALPS-FAS) {33963613}; many other mutations result in ALPS-like phenotype {34447369}; KRAS and NRAS somatic mutations can produce an ALPS-like phenotype {21063026} as well as myeloid manifestations {25691160; 33011939} (see <<8.0.0.5>>RASopathies)

Splenomegaly, lymphadenopathy, autoimmunity, lymphoproliferation

CHL, NLPHL, DLBCL, others {11418480; 21885602; 24398331; 20216376}

 

EBV susceptibility, B lymphoproliferation

Impaired elimination of proliferating EBV+ B cells and MYC-rearranged B cells, e.g. SH2D1A (XLP1) {9771704}, ITK deficiency {19425169}, CD70 deficiency, CD27 deficiency, MAGT1 deficiency (XMEN) {32451662}, CD137 (41BB) deficiency {31501153}

Severe primary EBV infection (IM) with HLH; CAEBV

XLP1: BL {19874894}, ITK deficiency: EBV+ CHL {31057537}, polymorphic or Hodgkin-like LPD often involving lung {25728094}, CD70 and CD27 deficiency, EBV+ CHL > EBV+ DLBCL {31057537; 32603431}, XMEN: EBV+ DLBCL, CHL, BL {31057537}

Other

 

SPTCL with germline HAVCR2 variants

Disinhibited T-cell–mediated immune response due to loss of function of HAVCR2 (TIM3) {30374066}

Associated with HLH

Reported in > 50% of patients with SPTCL in predominantly Asian case series {34535012; 30792187}; can involve mesentery {32285995}

diagnosis: Common variable immunodeficiency-associated reactive lymphoid hyperplasia involving bone marrow
legend: Bone marrow biopsy with scattered lymphoid aggregates containing ill-defined germinal centres; concurrent flow immunophenotyping shows no light chain–restricted population, and both plasma cells and normal B-cell precursors (haematogones) are markedly decreased.
